illustrationReview.finding: Permitted only for the Field Museum; former category fallback incorrectly showed this building for Ardmore and unrelated landmarks. Original art is a simplified architectural interpretation, not a photo.

Existing artwork has a generic pale villa façade and one central tower; visually differs from verified red-brick entrance façade with two towers. Regenerate from the verified photograph or omit the vignette.
Existing artwork changes the pavilion roof and tower silhouette. Regenerate from the verified photograph or omit the vignette.
Invented semicircular basin cannot stand in for the actual outlines of distinct named harbors. Use the mapped basins and docks.
Stylized architecture and scale require checking against the verified aerial. Keep a location anchor and do not let the silhouette replace the actual mapped pier footprint.
Stylized seating bowl and colonnade need geographic anchor and restrained scale. Verified exterior photo added.
